description: This file defines a singleton object 'StringUtils' providing string manipulation utilities such as join and split, which internally delegate to 'JoinUtils' and 'SplitUtils'.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Converts a LinkedList into a String by delegating to JoinUtils.join.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList by delegating to SplitUtils.split.
